example_source: README.rst, section 5: One-way ANOVA using a pandas DataFrame
readme_code:
# Read an example dataset
df = pg.read_dataset('mixed_anova')

# Run the ANOVA
aov = pg.anova(data=df, dv='Scores', between='Group', detailed=True)
print(aov)
comparison_rule: Compare each displayed numeric table value at README precision (3 decimal places; DF exact). Preserve unrounded returned CSV. Byte-compare both raw CSV artifacts without normalization.
environment_rule: Separate fresh venvs; same resolver-generated hashed lock from upstream pyproject runtime requirements; install each checkout without dependencies after syncing that lock. No upstream edits or bug fixes.
repeat_policy: Exactly two analysis invocations, one per clean clone. Failures remain failures. No analysis retries or patches.
output_serialization: Upstream README print(aov) captured as stdout; returned aov saved by harness as UTF-8 CSV, index=False, LF, default pandas float representation.
